clauses.quote: The Superintendent has the authority to temporarily suspend school personnel when, in opinion, the circumstances necessitate immediate action.
In addition, no employee shall have in his/her possession a firearm in or on school property or within tOOOfeet of a school.

Only security personnel who have law enforcement training approved by the APOSTC (Alabama Peace Officers Standards Training Commission) are authorized to carry firearms on school property or at school functions when and where faculty, staff, students or the general public are present, including after school activities and venues.
clauses.subject_text: Only security personnel who have law enforcement training approved by the APOSTC (Alabama Peace Officers Standards Training Commission)
clauses.notes: Security personnel are district employees, classified as worker here.

clauses.quote: School principals and other work site supervisors as may be designated are directed to post signs at the doors of all school buildings and on the grounds of school property.
clauses.subject_text: School principals and other work site supervisors as may be designated

clauses.quote: Parents/ guardians and other persons are hereby notified that they are prohibited from bringing firearms or other weapons on school property at any time.
Parents and other persons in violation of this policy will be asked to leave the campus and reported to law enforcement authorities.
clauses.subject_text: Parents and other persons in violation of this policy
clauses.notes: Imposes duty on management to ask and report violators.

clauses.quote: School officials will be expected to sign an arrest warrant for any person failing to leave the campus after being requested to do so or who uses a firearm in a threatening manner, attempts to harm or harms another individual on school property.
Any employee possessing a dangerous weapon will be reported to the proper authorities immediately.
clauses.subject_text: Any employee possessing a dangerous weapon
clauses.notes: Implicit agent is management/district staff tasked with reporting.

clauses.quote: The Superintendent upon notification shall temporarily place employee on administrative leave.

Following an investigation by the Superintendent, he or she will make a recommendation of disciplinary actions to the Board of Education, which may include but is not limited to the termination of the employee's employment with the school district.
